title: Board Brief: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals were bought without a specification for two years before the fire.
No check stopped an untested pump returning to service.

sections.heading: What happened and why it matters to the board

items.text: A pump was restarted after a seal change without a leak test and the seal failed [FND-0001; EVD-0001].

sections.heading: What the investigation says about the management system

items.text: Spares were bought locally without a specification, and assurance did not see the gap [FND-0003].

sections.heading: Questions for directors to ask management

items.question: How do we know critical spares meet their specification at every site?
items.why: Local purchasing bypassed the specification for two years.
items.good_evidence: A sampled audit of critical-spares purchase records against specifications.

items.question: Which equipment can return to service without a documented test?
items.good_evidence: A list of return-to-service hold points with test records.

items.name: Critical spares bought to specification
items.measure: % of critical-spares orders with a specification reference
